g.id: para · Each chew combines Bacillus velezensis, · start · 20 350
g.text: Each chew combines Bacillus velezensis, a live
gut-flora culture, with prebiotic inulin, psyllium
husk and pumpkin and squash seeds. It’s
designed to support healthy digestion, and most
dogs treat it as a treat.
